preconditions: Explicit Baseline record bytes, actual archive objects and a private owned external destination parent; every protected boundary is declared.
steps: Read stored Baseline data with freshly recomputed integrity, without writes or cached success.
Restore the verified whole-project snapshot without Git or current files, preserving exact resource bytes and semantic configuration hashes; reconstruct the root again from actual output bytes.
Reject missing archive objects, existing or overlapping destinations and invalid operational choices before publication; retain interrupted output without overwriting or claiming completion.
Inject missing/replaced destination directories and ensure no write falls back to the process cwd; reject foreign directories and byte-identical replacement of an owned file.
Check original objects again after output reconstruction, preserving actual interrupted files on late source/storage failure; restore an older Baseline and registry without any original project.
Re-run the unchanged W/R behavior tests after separating the unchanged read-only view from native materialization.

oracle.requirement_contract: `specroad baseline show <ID>` MUSS das gespeicherte Baseline-Manifest und einen neu berechneten Integritätsstatus ausgeben, ohne den Arbeitsstand zu verändern.
oracle.scope: Fresh stored-manifest integrity view and independent materialization of the already supported unconfigured whole-project snapshot; all semantic and binary bytes come from verified archived objects.

open_items: CLI lookup/dispatch and selected/configured scopes remain separate integrations. Native materialization supports a missing destination under a private owned canonical Linux parent; no resume, atomic whole-directory publication or cross-platform write claim.
